mapper.insert: INSERT INTO challenges (id, creator_id, title, description, start_date, end_date, target_count, challenge_type) VALUES (#{id}, #{creatorId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{targetCount}, #{challengeType})
mapper.select: SELECT id, creator_id, title, description, start_date, end_date, target_count, challenge_type, created_at FROM challenges ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO challenge_participants (id, challenge_id, user_id, target_count, current_count, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{challengeId}, #{userId}, #{targetCount}, 0, 'IN_PROGRESS')
mapper.select: SELECT cp.challenge_id, c.title AS challenge_title, cp.user_id, cp.current_count, cp.target_count, cp.status, cp.joined_at FROM challenge_participants cp JOIN challenges c ON c.id = cp.challenge_id WHERE cp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cp.joined_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE challenge_participants SET current_count = current_count + #{increment}, status = CASE WHEN current_count + #{increment} >= target_count THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
